parts.stem:
Nickel can form complexes with the ligands $en$, $\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$, and $tn$, $\text{H}_2\text{NCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{NH}_2$, as shown.

equilibrium 1 $\quad [\text{Ni}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+} + 3en \rightleftharpoons [\text{Ni}(en)_3]^{2+} + 6\text{H}_2\text{O} \quad K_{stab} = 6.76 \times 10^{17}$

equilibrium 2 $\quad [\text{Ni}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+} + 3tn \rightleftharpoons [\text{Ni}(tn)_3]^{2+} + 6\text{H}_2\text{O} \quad K_{stab} = 1.86 \times 10^{12}$
